decision_1_valuation_basis.selected_option: Option 1D — Explicit Exclusion of Monetary Valuation from Production
decision_1_valuation_basis.evidence_summary: unit_iv is a constant per SKU across all 24 months (std <= 8.27e-13). Diverges from Cost_Price by 136.9% and Selling_Price by 164.9%. No authoritative GL/ERP table exists in repository.
decision_1_valuation_basis.conditions_for_unblocking: Formal delivery of ERP standard cost or GL costing feed approved by Finance.

decision_2_on_order_policy.selected_option: Option 2A — Ratify Policy B_LT as Operational Interim Baseline
decision_2_on_order_policy.evidence_summary: 100% of observed supplier lead times are between 3 and 14 days (mean 8.49 days, std 3.53 days). No PO line-item schedule exists in data. Policy B_LT accurately maps arrival within the 2-week window without day-1 over-optimism.
decision_2_on_order_policy.conditions_for_advancement: Optional future integration of ERP PO milestone feed if discrete tracking is required.

decision_3_overstock_threshold.selected_option: Option 3C — Ratify N = 8 Weeks as Operational Overstock Policy
decision_3_overstock_threshold.evidence_summary: Directly aligns with 8-week production ML forecasting horizon. Produces 25.57% alert rate with 0% false alarms on balanced SKUs. Avoids N=4 week alert fatigue (52.2% alert rate) and unsupported N>8 extrapolation.

condition_1_valuation.detail: Monetary metrics safely and explicitly excluded under Option 1D.

condition_2_on_order.detail: Policy B_LT formally ratified as operational interim baseline under Option 2A.

condition_3_overstock.detail: N=8 weeks formally ratified under Option 3C.
